Subject: Tax ID verification & payment collection timeline (NordicCloud)

Hi Sofie / NordicCloud AP,

Thanks again for the quick onboarding call last week. We have the first invoice ready to go for the May usage run (invoice #RWI-2027-05-001). Before we release the funds and mark the invoice paid, our payment team needs formal proof of your Swedish VAT registration so we can apply the EU reverse-charge for cross-border B2B services. Specifically we need: 

- Company name and registered VAT number (exact string as on government record)
- A scanned copy / PDF of the national VAT certificate or a screenshot from the Swedish tax portal showing active status
- Confirmation of the registered billing entity and country of registration

Why this matters: if we can validate your VAT ID, Redwood will reissue the invoice net of VAT (reverse-charge) and the payment can be processed to our account without VAT withheld. If we cannot validate it, AP may need to collect VAT locally which will delay settlement and could change the gross amount.

Attached: taxproof-request.pdf — a short checklist your AP team can use to confirm the fields we need.

Could you please share the PDF or a link to the certificate by EOD Friday (14 May)? If you expect a delay we can propose a short alternative workflow (self-billing or interim credit hold) — happy to outline options.

Thanks,
Sean

Sean / team — looping in Ben to confirm billing ops. Quick notes from finance for clarity and proposed collection cadence: 

1) Certificate check: the Swedish PDF looks valid from a quick glance but we need to run the VAT number through our EU VAT lookup (VIES) and store a copy in the customer tax evidence bucket. If VIES returns active and matches the company name we can proceed with reverse-charge.

2) Two operational paths (pick one):
  - Path A (preferred): Redwood reissues the invoice net of VAT once VIES is confirmed. AP releases payment to Redwood account within our normal net-30 terms. We mark invoice as settled for revenue recognition and close.
  - Path B (if VIES mismatch or certificate delay): Redwood issues the invoice including VAT. NordicCloud pays gross; once evidence is supplied (retroactive validation) we will process a credit/reversal and reissue net invoice. This has more bookkeeping friction and may delay final settlement by ~2–3 weeks.

3) Interim hold: If AP wants, we can accept a signed self-billing agreement (short form) that lets us issue a self-billed invoice net of VAT immediately. That requires a signed DocuSign from NordicCloud AP.

4) Collection schedule: propose we trigger payment processing on receipt of either (a) VIES-validated VAT id + certificate, or (b) signed self-billing agreement. If we do not receive either by close of business 14 May, finance will place the invoice on a 10-business-day hold and flag it to revenue ops.

Attached: collection_cutover_instructions.docx — short ops checklist for AP teams.

Ben — can you start the VIES check and confirm by EOD?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Account Success | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
